draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Shivamogga! This city on the Tunga River is nicknamed the Gateway to Malnad, since it opens onto the hills of the Western Ghats.
draft.hungryLine: My notes don't list restaurants here, but for something different, locals suggest having lunch at one of the temples.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at Shivappa Nayaka Palace by the Tunga, then the Sacred Heart Church in the heart of the city. Tyavarekoppa Lion and Tiger Safari is about 11 km out.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Mandagadde Bird Sanctuary, about 32 km away, has a high platform by the Tunga for watching egrets, cormorants and darters.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Sacred Heart Church here is said to be the second largest church in India, with a prayer hall that holds up to 5000 people.

spots.name: Shivappa Nayaka Palace
spots.detail: By the Tunga · A 16th century rosewood palace with a museum

spots.name: Elephant Training Camp-Sakrebylu
spots.detail: About 14 km away · Watch elephants bathe in the river

spots.name: Tyavarekoppa Lion and Tiger Safari
spots.detail: About 11 km away · Lions and tigers in big enclosures

legends.title: The face of Shiva
legends.body: Locals say the name comes from Shiva-mukha, the face of Lord Shiva. That's how Shimoga became Shivamogga.

tips.title: Go early for the elephants.
tips.body: At Sakrebylu the elephants bathe in the morning, so get there before 9AM to catch them.

tips.title: Try a temple lunch.
tips.body: Lunch at a local temple is a very different food experience worth trying.

story.title: A Keladi palace
story.body: Shivappa Naik of Keladi built a palace of rosewood on the banks of the Tunga. Today it holds stone carvings and antiques from the Keladi period.

story.title: The fort falls
story.body: On 3 January 1792, during the Third Anglo-Mysore War, the Maratha leader Purseram Bhow took Shimoga's fort after its walls were breached.

story.title: The railway arrives
story.body: The Birur to Shivamogga line opened on 1 December 1889, making this one of the earliest railway stations in Karnataka.

story.title: A university town
story.body: Kuvempu University was set up in 1987, with its green Jnana Sahyadri campus near the city.

story.title: A smart city
story.body: The city was picked for the Smart Cities Mission, ranking fourth in the state as of November 2020.
